decisions.decision: T-251 landed on main as 91af003, so branch from current main instead of tantra-walkthroughs. Part A: in jobs-twilio.ts, automate the regulatory bundle (Bundles, EndUsers, SupportingDocuments), the IncomingPhoneNumbers purchase with BundleSid, the Browser Rendering /screenshot attached to toll-free verification, and the Balance.json check that blocks below $20. Add the matching vendor-sim routes and prove a non-US number purchase with its bundle. Part B: remove every Twilio WhatsApp item the spec lists. Point the reminders card and the S3/S6/S5 guides at the Tantra omni-channel campaign with webhook registrant import, reusing T-217's import code. Check the Tantra API docs for whether WhatsApp needs pre-approved templates; if they don't say, write the step without any template claim and note it in T-253. Update AUDIT.md with the commit, run the probes, merge, deploy, republish the mirror.
decisions.why: T-251 log 2026-10-08: merged to main 91af003. Owner rule 2026-10-07 (google-and-reminder-model): WhatsApp through Tantra campaigns, never Twilio. Write paths use vendor-sim only (vendor-accounts-no-change-rule). The open docs question can be settled from Tantra's public docs.
